description: Use when an agent needs to be told when something changes without polling. Input: type (price, balance, stablecoin_transfer, filing, sanctions, web_status), its target and condition, days 7-30, optional https webhook. Output: id, one-time secret, poll URL. Checked every 5-60 min; events by poll or HMAC-signed webhook. $0.002/day ($0.004 web_status), paid once. Best-effort, no SLA; not refunded. Example: POST {"type":"price","symbol":"ETH","below":2000} Price: $0.014–$0.12 USDC via x402.

above.description: price/balance: fire when the value rises above this (USD for price, token units for balance); give above or below, not both

address.description: balance: wallet (0x…); sanctions: any crypto address; stablecoin_transfer: optional from/to filter

below.description: price/balance: fire when the value falls below this

chain.description: balance: base, ethereum, arbitrum, monad; stablecoin_transfer: ethereum, base, arbitrum

cik.description: filing: SEC Central Index Key (alternative to ticker)

corp.description: filing: Korean company (DART corp_code, stock code or kr-dart- id) instead of ticker

days.description: Watch length in days, 7-30 (default 7); price = days × daily rate

items.description: filing (SEC): only 8-Ks with these item codes, e.g. 2.02,5.02

min_usd.description: stablecoin_transfer: minimum transfer size in USD (default 100000)

symbol.description: price: one ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL, …; DEX-priced like /v1/crypto/price)

ticker.description: filing: US ticker or use cik (SEC EDGAR); fires on each new filing

token.description: balance: token symbol from the default set (e.g. USDC) or NATIVE (default); any change fires when no above/below

type.description: What to watch. Without type the request is a price probe (402 at the 7-day minimum)

url.description: web_status: site to check every 15 min; fires on up/down or status change

webhook.description: Optional https URL (port 443, public host) for signed POSTs: header x-1gateway-signature t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256(key=hex(SHA-256(secret)), `${t}.${body}`)

name: watch_create
title: Watch & alert: price, wallet balance, whale transfers, filings, sanctions or site status, by poll or signed webhook
